columns.name: component
columns.description: Which part of the product the bug affects.

columns.name: triage_reasoning
columns.description: Why the agent assigned this priority/component — transparency for reviewers.

columns.name: reporter
columns.description: Who reported it (name/handle parsed from the message), if known.

columns.name: duplicate_of
columns.description: If this is a duplicate, the id of the canonical bug it duplicates. Null otherwise.

columns.name: release_note
columns.description: Approved user-facing release note, written by the release-notes workflow.

columns.name: release_notes_approved
columns.description: True once a human approved the release note. Also guards the workflow from re-firing.
